businesses.business: Oilfield laboratory services and completion products

offering_description.value: Core Laboratories analyzes reservoir rock, fluids and petroleum products for oil and gas producers, refiners and traders. It provides well completion and production diagnostics through laboratory testing and field measurements, and manufactures perforating equipment for oilfield operators and service companies.

primary_products.value: Perforating gun systems; shaped charges; downhole perforating accessories

primary_services.value: Reservoir rock and fluid analysis; crude oil and refined product testing; reservoir characterization studies; well completion and production diagnostics

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas producers, refiners, petroleum traders and oilfield service companies

end_markets.value: Oil and gas exploration and production; petroleum refining; petroleum trading

revenue_model.value: service fees: Laboratory analyses, petroleum testing and well diagnostics; product sales: Perforating systems, shaped charges and related hardware; project or contract: Commissioned and multi-client reservoir characterization studies
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Analyzes rock, fluid and petroleum samples for producers, refiners and traders; OEM / manufacturer: Builds perforating systems from metal and energetic components for producers and oilfield service firms

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Reservoir characterization, petroleum testing, well diagnostics and perforating products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Technical sales teams serving oil and gas operators, refiners and oilfield service companies; own locations: Company-operated laboratories that receive and analyze customer samples

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Laboratory chemical handling and waste rules, plus explosives licensing and hazardous materials transport requirements for perforating products.
